summary: Phase 4 Enhanced Spectator Betting - All 14/14 backend tests passed and all frontend UI features verified. Betting panel with live odds, multiplier calculation, and agent selection working correctly. Live odds ticker displays at top during active games with bets.

backend: GET /api/bets/game/{game_id}/odds returns proper structure (total_pool, total_bets, odds[])
Each agent in odds has required fields: agent_id, agent_name, multiplier, pool, bets_count, pct, folded
Odds multiplier = (total_pool * 0.8) / agent_pool for agents with bets
Default multiplier = active_players * 0.8 for agents with no bets
POST /api/bets rejects bets for non-existent games (404)
POST /api/bets rejects bets on agents not in the game (400)
POST /api/bets creates pending bet for authenticated users
POST /api/bets rejects bets on completed/showdown games (400)
GET /api/bets/my-bets returns user's bet history with proper structure
Agent users can also place side bets
Game flow: start game -> advance phases -> complete works correctly
frontend: BettingPanel shows during active game phases (preflop, flop, turn, river)
BettingPanel hidden during waiting/showdown/complete phases (correct behavior)
BettingPanel shows all active (non-folded) agents with their multipliers
Multiplier displays correctly (3.2x default for 4 active players with no bets)
Multiplier updates after bet (0.8x shown for agent with bet)
Bet amount slider works (10-1000 SC range)
Place bet button changes from 'SELECT AN AGENT' to 'BET X SC' after selection
'Bet placed: 50 SC' toast notification shows on success
'Your Bets' section appears after placing bet with bet details
'You bet X SC' indicator shows under selected agent
Live odds ticker shows at top during active game with bets
Bet pool badge shows (e.g., '1 bets / 50 SC pool')
Potential win calculation displays after agent selection

seed_data_creation: Test bets created during testing with amounts 50 SC
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 spectator betting fully implemented and tested. BettingPanel component shows live odds polling every 5 seconds from /api/bets/game/{id}/odds. Odds multiplier formula: (total_pool * 0.8) / agent_pool. Default multiplier for no bets: active_players * 0.8. House rake is 20% on the pool. Betting only allowed during active phases (preflop, flop, turn, river). Bet settlement happens on game completion in /api/games/{id}/advance endpoint.

mocked_apis.ai_agent_decisions: MOCKED - AI agent decisions simulated in game_engine.py
mocked_apis.bet_settlement: REAL but triggered automatically - Proportional payouts distributed when game completes

betting_flow.step1: User views table with active game (preflop/flop/turn/river phase)
betting_flow.step2: BettingPanel shows all non-folded agents with live odds multipliers
betting_flow.step3: User selects agent and amount (10-1000 SC via slider)
betting_flow.step5: User clicks place bet -> POST /api/bets -> deducts SC from wallet
betting_flow.step6: Bet added to pool, odds refresh every 5-6 seconds
betting_flow.step7: On game complete: winners get proportional payout with 20% house rake

verified_multiplier_logic.example: 4 active players with no bets -> 3.2x multiplier each
